quests.title: The Lantern Road
quests.blurb: Mara’s grandmother kept the lantern road east of here. The lamp on Ashwatch hill has been dark thirty years.

steps.goal: Hear Mara out about the road
steps.objective: Mara has a question for you about the dark lantern road. Find her in the Hearthwick square.

steps.goal: Copy the route stone in Ashwatch Ruin
steps.objective: Leave by the east gate, cross Brackenwood, and copy the naming cut on the route stone in Ashwatch Ruin.

steps.goal: Settle the stone warden
steps.objective: Settle the stone warden: when it stops after a lunge, get close and speak the naming.

steps.goal: Light the lantern at the shrine
steps.objective: Light the hilltop lantern at the old shrine.

steps.goal: Tell Mara the light is back
steps.objective: Return to Mara in Hearthwick and tell her the light is back.

quests.title: Three Fingers off Plumb
quests.blurb: The frost stood Orrin’s signpost up straight, and he won’t have it.

steps.goal: See what Orrin’s grumbling about
steps.objective: Someone up a ladder by the signpost in the square is arguing with it. Go and see.

steps.goal: Find the signpost’s east finger
steps.objective: The frost threw the signpost’s east finger out past the east gate, into the bracken. A wisp has settled on it. Shoo it off and bring the finger back to Orrin.

note.title: A Wisp on the Finger
note.body: A wisp had settled on Orrin’s signpost finger and was glowing at the paint. One good swing and it hopped off into the bracken to sulk. The finger says ASHWATCH in fresh paint. Under it, older and nearly gone: SALLOW FD.

steps.goal: Take the finger back to Orrin
steps.objective: Bring the east finger back to Orrin at the signpost.

steps.goal: Write the lean in your journal
steps.objective: Orrin won’t set the post until the lean is written down: three fingers off plumb, leaning east. Open your journal and note it.

note.title: Three Fingers off Plumb
note.body: Orrin’s signpost: three fingers off plumb, leaning east. He made me write it down. He says it’s the frost. I don’t think it’s the frost.

steps.goal: Read the lean back to Orrin
steps.objective: Read the lean back to Orrin so he can set the post.

steps.goal: Find Mara and her ledger
steps.objective: Pip says Mara has the ledger open in the square and the soup on. Go and see her.

note.title: In the Ledger
note.body: Mara wrote the signpost into her grandmother’s ledger: ‘East finger recovered, lean set. Traveller’s hand.’ Work done and written down is warmth you carry, she says. Here they call it embers.

steps.goal: Light the first lamp past the gate
steps.objective: The road lantern just past the east gate has been dark for thirty years. Light it with your embers.

note.title: The First Lamp
note.body: Lit the road lantern past the east gate. Back in the square, Mara stood up from the ledger to look.

quests.title: Your Own Day
quests.blurb: Mara will write in what you get done in your own day.

steps.goal: Ask Mara about your own day
steps.objective: Mara says whatever you get done in your own day counts. Ask her what she means.

steps.goal: Bring Mara something from your day
steps.objective: Tick off a task, a daily or a habit in Habitica. Every 10 XP you earn there becomes an ember. Then sync from the Menu in Hearthwick or the Commons.

steps.goal: Show Mara what you did
steps.objective: Tell Mara what you got done, and she’ll write it in.

note.title: A Punched Token
note.body: Mara didn’t ask what I did, only whether it was done. She punched an old wheel-tax token and gave it to me. ‘Receipted,’ she said. ‘The Count House would’ve wanted it.’

quests.title: Set to Rise
quests.blurb: Hazel’s starter wants feeding, and Finn has the flour.

steps.goal: See what Hazel needs
steps.objective: Hazel has a sponge that wants feeding. Find her in her kitchen or out with the basket.

steps.goal: Bring Hazel a sack of flour
steps.objective: Hazel’s out of the fine sift. Finn sells it at the mill, a sack an ember.

steps.goal: Help Hazel set the sponge
steps.objective: Take the flour to Hazel in her kitchen and set the sponge with her.

steps.goal: Come back when it has risen
steps.objective: A sponge won’t be hurried. Come back to Hazel’s kitchen in a couple of hours.

note.title: Set to Rise
note.body: Hazel says you can’t hurry a sponge, only leave it somewhere warm and trust it. Two twists for my trouble, still hot. She burnt the ends of one on purpose.

quests.title: The Stuck Hoist
quests.blurb: Finn can’t get his sacks down: the hoist in the loft has seized.

steps.goal: See what’s troubling Finn
steps.objective: Finn is counting the wrong thing again. Find him at the mill.

steps.goal: Look at the hoist in the sack loft
steps.objective: The sack hoist is up in the mill’s loft, over the hatch. The stairs are at the back. Mind the third one.

steps.goal: Get a lump of tallow from Hazel
steps.objective: The hoist’s pulley is dry as a bone. Hazel sells tallow from her kitchen, an ember a lump.

steps.goal: Grease the hoist
steps.objective: Take the tallow up to the sack loft and work it into the hoist’s pulley.

steps.goal: Tell Finn the hoist runs
steps.objective: The hoist turns again. Go and tell Finn before he counts another sack by hand.

note.title: Forty Turns and a Squeak
note.body: Greased Finn’s sack hoist. He sent a sack down the hatch and counted the pulley round: forty turns and a squeak. ‘The squeak’s fine,’ he said. ‘The squeak was always there. I’d miss it.’

quests.title: A Seat by the Lamp
quests.blurb: The library’s reading lamp wants oil, and the oil wants an ember.

steps.goal: Look inside the library
steps.objective: The small reading house stands on the square’s quiet side. Step in.

steps.goal: Browse the tall shelves
steps.objective: The village keeps its papers on the tall shelves at the back. Have a look.

steps.goal: Oil the reading lamp
steps.objective: The lamp on the reading table is dry. A note on it in Mara’s hand: ‘One ember the oil. Ledger. — M.H.’

steps.goal: Sit and read by the lamp
steps.objective: The lamp is lit. Take a seat at the reading table and read a while.

note.title: A Seat by the Lamp
note.body: Paid an ember for the library lamp’s oil and sat under it with a paper till the light went gold. Mara’s note was still tied to the lamp. Somebody had written under it, in a different hand: ‘Worth it.’
